mathematical_contract.construction: Hypersolve constructs the selected arithmetic image of two represented roots by an exact rational resultant and a Sturm-certified image isolator. Cubic-by-cubic images are admitted at the minimal required resultant-degree bound of nine.
mathematical_contract.selected_root_proof: Hypercurve separately compares the constructed image with the third authored representation using exact refinement, common-root replay, and difference construction. Polynomial-factor coincidence alone is never accepted as equality of the selected roots.
mathematical_contract.canonical_relations: Testing z=x+y for each axis permutation covers addition and subtraction because z=x-y is equivalent to x=z+y. Testing z=x*y for each permutation covers multiplication and division because z=x/y is equivalent to x=z*y. Bezier parameters are retained in the closed unit interval.
mathematical_contract.interval_gate: Exact source isolator endpoints bound sums directly and products monotonically on [0,1]. Disjoint image/result intervals reject a candidate before resultant construction; undecided or nonstandard bounds conservatively retain the candidate.
mathematical_contract.sum_substitution: For z=x+y, every z^k is expanded exactly as sum_j binomial(k,j)*x^(k-j)*y^j, producing one bounded bivariate tensor.
mathematical_contract.product_substitution: For z=x*y, each monomial x^i*y^j*z^k maps exactly to x^(i+k)*y^(j+k), producing one bounded bivariate tensor without a power table.
mathematical_contract.post_substitution_authority: The resulting bivariate value is decided by Hypercurve's strict direct, common-fiber, and refinement authorities. No approximate arithmetic participates in a Certified result.
mathematical_contract.resource_bound: Checked output dimensions preserve the existing 16384-control ceiling. Unsupported arithmetic, degree overflow, nonisolating images, or unresolved selected-root comparison returns no exact claim.
mathematical_contract.policy: Supported sum/product identities are Certified under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption. The remaining rational three-field control is Predicate uncertainty in STRICT and may return Zero only after APPROXIMATE_512 records the shared terminal.
mathematical_contract.failure: No floating tolerance, sampled equality, guessed conjugate, compatibility shim, or second Boolean engine is introduced.

capability.comparison_revision: The cubic identity (a*b-c)*(1+a)*(1+b)*(1+c), with a^3=1/2, b^3=1/3, and c^3=1/6, was nonlinear below every defining degree. STRICT was uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 consumed its terminal.
capability.source_revision: Hypersolve now constructs the exact selected product a*b, proves that it is the authored c, and Hypercurve substitutes c=a*b before invoking the bivariate sign authority. The corresponding independently represented cubic-sum identity follows the same graph.
capability.multiplicative_fixture: All three placements of the product root return Certified Zero under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512; neither policy consumes its terminal.
capability.additive_fixture: For a^3=1/20, b^3=1/30, and the selected degree-nine root s=a+b, all three placements of s return Certified Zero under both policies.
capability.differential_axis_coverage: A dense 3x4x2 tensor receives exact sum and product substitution in all six ordered axis arrangements, and every bivariate evaluation equals direct trivariate evaluation.
capability.foreign_root_coverage: A selected cubic root unrelated to a*b is rejected even though the arithmetic package remains capable of constructing the product.
capability.remaining_policy_control: For a^3=1/2, b^3=1/3, and c=a*b/(a+b), the quadratic-in-every-axis zero a*b-c*(a+b) is not a pairwise sum or product relation. STRICT remains explicitly uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 consumes the terminal.
capability.remaining_exactness_boundary: Prove general low-degree rational relations among three selected roots or construct a bounded compositum only when quotient, affine, linear-resultant, sum, and product reductions all fail.
